meta.description: Misconception remediation paths for Unit 2 practice MCQs

myopia_hypermetropia_swap.feedback: Check whether distant or nearby objects are blurred — that identifies myopia vs hypermetropia.
myopia_hypermetropia_swap.calm_prompt: Myopia: far blur. Hypermetropia: near blur.

concave_convex_correction_swap.feedback: Myopia needs a diverging (concave) lens; hypermetropia needs a converging (convex) lens.
concave_convex_correction_swap.calm_prompt: Concave for myopia, convex for hypermetropia.

dispersion_scattering_swap.feedback: Dispersion splits white light in a prism; scattering redirects light off particles in air.
